A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same InfGen study. All 20 pages of each, including Appendices A–G, are readable, and the text, equations, tables and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original WOMD/WOSAC simulation results, token ablations and qualitative analyses, including Tables 1–4 and Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v2 retains original simulation results in Tables 1–3 and the ablation results in Appendix E.2, Table 5, alongside qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendices B–D retain the same tokenizers, interleaved transformer, control tokens, training objectives and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use WOMD/WOSAC for short-term and 30-second traffic simulation. The changed selection of illustrated rollouts does not establish a change in the datasets or scenarios actually evaluated.

E2.justification: Short-term comparisons retain TrafficBots, GUMP, SMART-7M and CatK. Long-term and motion-only tables retain SMART-7M and CatK, and the qualitative comparisons retain SMART.

E3.justification: The same historical inputs, rollout durations, adapted WOSAC and ACE metrics, training settings and 2,204-scenario ablation subset are reported. Moving the ablation study does not change its protocol.

E4.justification: The parking-lot/open-area qualitative example shown as the fourth case in v1 Figure 5 is omitted from v2. Token ablations, motion-only analysis, metric-over-time analysis and failure cases remain; the ablation study moves from Section 5.4 to Appendix E.2.

E5.justification: The tables and metric curves retain the same statistical reporting. Neither version adds or revises seed information, repeated-run counts or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All quantitative results match, including InfGen's long-term composite score of 0.6606 and Mean ACE of 8.1. Qualitative result entries change slightly through omission of the parking-lot example; other altered panels are relocated or rendered at higher resolution.

T1.justification: The mathematical content in Equations 1–18, including rollout factorizations, attention formulations, token definitions, masked losses and the hybrid attention mask, is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims: unified interleaved motion and scene generation, stable long-term rollouts and competitive short-term simulation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of token benefits and simulation performance remain unchanged. Section 6 and Appendix F retain the same limitations concerning map extent, supervised learning, insertion failures, flickering agents and long-context reasoning.

D1.justification: The approximately 11M-parameter configuration, hyperparameters, hardware, implementation details and training masks are retained. The code/model release statement, project access information and asset licenses also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 46 cited works and research positioning. Changed reference backlinks reflect pagination and relocation, rather than added literature or revised relationships to prior work.

P1.justification: v2 moves Section 5.4 to Appendix E.2, adds an appendix contents overview and subsection headings, and renames Appendix A to Demo Video. Most prose is unchanged, but the new supplementary-results pointer contains an unresolved 'Sec. ??' reference.

P2.justification: Figure 5 shrinks from five displayed cases to three, with one case moved to Figure 11 and the parking-lot case omitted. v2 corrects an overlaid duplicate panel and increases several panel resolutions. Tables are relocated and renumbered, and printed page numbers disappear; Figure 5's caption incorrectly still says five scenarios.

improvement.justification: The method and quantitative evidence remain unchanged. The appendix overview and corrected duplicate panel help presentation, but v2 introduces 'Sec. ??' and retains a five-scenario caption and discussion of a fourth case after reducing Figure 5 to three cases and omitting the parking-lot example. These inconsistencies modestly weaken clarity and the connection between the discussion and its supporting evidence.
